cinematic: Cinematic film still in the evening or night, shot on 35mm Kodak Portra 800, visible film grain, slight halation around lights, soft focus falloff, natural imperfect framing. Warm, hopeful, cozy atmosphere: plenty of warm golden practical light (lamps, windows, string lights, street lights) against a soft blue night, the scene feels safe, gentle and alive, never gloomy, scary or lonely. Minimal composition: ONE clear subject with calm negative space, few background elements, nothing cluttered. Realistic human scale and proportions between people, objects and buildings. Faces must NOT be clearly visible: show people from behind, in silhouette, or small and far away. Vertical 9:16 phone wallpaper. Not glossy, not over-sharpened, no HDR, no watermark, no logo
anime: Hand-painted anime film background in the spirit of Makoto Shinkai and Studio Ghibli, evening or night, warm glowing lights and a soft blue sky, hopeful and gentle mood. Minimal composition: ONE clear subject with large calm areas of sky or empty space; few details, nothing crowded or busy. Realistic scale between people, objects and landscape. Subtle paper texture and gentle grain. Vertical 9:16 phone wallpaper, no watermark, no logo
text_rule: Add the given line ONLY as a small movie-subtitle caption: lowercase, thin white serif italic, single line, centred about one quarter of the image height above the bottom edge (never at the very bottom), like a film subtitle.
